_comment: Tier-2 for febio::biphasic#3, and the fixture that FALSIFIED one entry of its solver list. Twenty registered FELINEARSOLVER_ID names swept on the shipped confined-compression deck, each asserted into a named bucket: matrix-format error (12 names), 'Linear solver failed to find solution' (LU), 'Fatal error in factorization' (ilu0, ilut), 'An error occurred during preprocessing' (block), not a registered type (pardiso), needs a sub-solver (strategy), needs A_solver (schur), runs (bicgstab, test). The claim listed `strategy` among the matrix-format emitters; it is refused at PARSE with 'Component "linear_solver" needs to have property "solver1" defined' and never reaches the matrix. Pitfall corrected in the same pass. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'biphasic_solver_sweep=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
